device.description: Network interface to monitor (e.g., eth0, enp0s3)

bpf_filter.description: BPF filter expression to select packets

mode.description: Display mode; must be one of: ascii, utf8, text, horizontal, vertical, history, legend, inverse, normal

table.description: iptables table name when using iptables/ip6tables source

chain.description: iptables chain name when using iptables/ip6tables source

select_rule.description: Empty string or 'select'/'select6' for interactive rule selection mode
